description:
Yesterday-Today-and-Tomorrow (Brunfelsia pauciflora) is a flowering shrub known for its blossoms that change color from purple to white over several days. All parts of this plant are toxic to cats and can cause serious neurological and gastrointestinal symptoms if ingested.

The plant contains several toxic compounds, including brunfelsamidine, which affects the central nervous system. Ingestion can lead to a dangerous combination of effects, often starting with stimulation (agitation, tremors) and progressing to depression (lethargy, and in severe cases, coma).

Signs of poisoning include vomiting, drooling, muscle tremors, loss of coordination, and seizures. The alternating periods of agitation and sedation are a characteristic sign. Because the neurological symptoms can escalate quickly, any suspected ingestion should be treated as a medical emergency. Please contact a veterinarian immediately if you think your cat has chewed on this plant.
name: Yesterday-today-and-tomorrow
safetyNotes: Toxic compounds: brunfelsamidine and related steroidal alkaloids; all parts of the plant are toxic
Mechanism: alkaloids affect the central nervous system, causing excitation and then CNS depression
Symptoms: vomiting, diarrhea, muscle tremors, seizures, hyperthermia; characteristically produces a syndrome that alternates agitation with sedation
Frequently used as a decorative garden shrub in tropical regions — keep cats away from the garden
Seek veterinary care promptly if ingestion is suspected; the neurological syndrome can escalate rapidly

symptoms.name: Depression, deep sedation, and sometimes coma
